title: Teenage prodigy determined to lift billiards back into PH mainstream
summary: For most 10-year-olds, P10 is barely enough for a snack. For rising cue artist Rhaki Roj Constantino, it was enough to begin a journey toward becoming the next star in Filipino billiards.
